claim: Sample data never changes your real draft.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a seeded ordinary draft; /demo edit, reset, and exit preserve the ordinary key and discard the demo key

claim: The demo loads the two-state Signal Hollow sample and shows a caption rehearsal control immediately.
where: landing action note, README local authoring site, demo route
sandbox: fresh context clicks the landing demo action, then asserts both named sample states, a realistic caption, and the rehearsal control intersect the first viewport

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated browser context; visit /demo, wait for the controlling worker, set offline, reload, and assert the sample workspace

claim: Project content and speech text are not sent to a product service.
sandbox: fresh /demo flow records every request through editing and Speak, asserts same-origin-only requests, no cookies, and demo-only storage
fresh ordinary workspace imports a shipped JSON fixture while request capture asserts same-origin-only traffic and the imported state appears
fresh /demo context authors a cue and asserts no sign-in or payment control appears

claim: Author localized captions and rehearse the action order with a keyboard.
sandbox: fresh /demo context edits a caption and uses ArrowRight and End in the rehearsal monitor

claim: Projects stay in the current browser until you export them.
sandbox: fresh ordinary workspace authors a state, reloads, and asserts the saved state is restored from the ordinary browser-storage key

claim: Localized captions use language tags, and speech uses the language of the action text.
where: README usage notes and Public API
sandbox: library fixture rejects an invalid tag, falls an English action back from Spanish, and asserts English speech language

claim: mount() adds a polite announcement unless liveRegion is disabled.
where: README usage notes and Public API
sandbox: library DOM fixture asserts the managed polite region is adjacent to the supplied element and is omitted when disabled

claim: The documented library API registers states, announces activation, supports review keys, and cleans up generated browser resources.
sandbox: library fixture performs the documented state, locale, focus, subscription, and cleanup flow

claim: Invalid IDs, language tags, duplicate state or action IDs, and blank descriptions throw CaptionerValidationError that names the invalid field.
sandbox: table-driven library fixture supplies each invalid input and asserts CaptionerValidationError plus an error message naming the invalid field

claim: Export the demo project as JSON.
sandbox: fresh /demo context exports the sample and parses the downloaded version 1 Signal Hollow JSON
